sloka: किमेष वाक्यं भरतो ऽद्य राघवं प्रणम्य सत्कृत्य च साधु वक्ष्यति ।इतीव तस्यार्यजनस्य तत्त्वतो बभूव कौतूहलमुत्तमं तदा ॥ २.१०३.३१॥
transliteration: kimeṣa vākyaṁ bharato 'dya rāghavaṁ praṇamya satkṛtya ca sādhu vakṣyati ।itīva tasyāryajanasya tattvato babhūva kautūhalamuttamaṁ tadā ॥ 2.103.31॥

translations.english: All noble people were truly filled with great curiosity as to what Bharata was going to speak, after paying his homage and honouring Rama.
